limitations.quote: Switch lights and load the next countdown on the same edge.
limitations.note: The rewrite eliminated the repeated green reload, but it also replaced the original pipelined timing and asserted red during reset, whereas the reference only changes the green reload condition to `!green && p_green`.
The testbench expected the rewrite’s immediate red reset and direct countdown transitions, so its passing result could not catch the timing changes that caused the grading mismatch.
The agent consulted the relevant timing skill, but the record shows no trace of the original state-to-buffer-to-output timing before it replaced that pipeline.
